content.title: Denso eyes price negotiations, not panic, against Trump's tariffs
content.summary: The world's second-largest car parts maker is not unduly worried about U.S. President Donald Trump's looming tariffs on Mexico and Canada, and may seek to manage increased costs by raising prices, a top executive at Japan's Denso said on Friday.  Yasushi Matsui, the Toyota Motor supplier's financial officer, provided insight into how some of Japan's biggest corporations aim to navigate potential higher import taxes in the U.S.  His comments also highlighted the possible impact of Trump's trade policies on global automakers and consumers by disrupting the supply chain.
